name: Slideshow Fade Collapse
description: Full-screen image slideshow where the current slide shrinks and fades while the next slides in vertically with an inner parallax, driven by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint label with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag navigate between slides via GSAP Observer
Current slide scales down and fades, then exits upward while the next slides in from below with inner image parallax
Loops from last slide back to first
Images are preloaded before the slideshow becomes visible
editableByProps: Transition timing, easing, shrink amount and parallax strength
Scroll sensitivity, nav button visibility, size and colors, hint text

needsCodeEdit.where: yPercent values in the timeline inside the navigate function
The ← and → buttons in the showNavButtons block

fixed: Wheel, touch and drag input on the slideshow is captured by GSAP Observer
Root is full viewport height and stays hidden until images are preloaded
